# Theme 2: Data Preparation & Understanding {.unnumbered}

In Theme 1 you trained models on datasets that were ready to use, and in the End-to-End ML Project you went through all stages of a project once. Real data is rarely ready to use. In this theme you study the two data stages in depth: preparing the data and exploring it.

Data Preparation comes before Data Understanding in this theme, the other way around from CRISP-DM. To understand a dataset, you often have to prepare it first, for example scale features before you compare them. The [End-to-End ML Project](015_end_to_end_ml.ipynb) explains this order in more detail.

## Activities

Work through the activities in order:

1. [Data Preparation](005_data_prep.ipynb): scaling, transforming, merging and encoding data, and handling missing values.
2. [Data Understanding](006_data_understanding.ipynb): distributions, relationships between variables, and principal component analysis (PCA).

In [Theme 3](theme-3.qmd), you learn to evaluate and compare models, and you look inside three of them.
